BTC.name: Bitcoin
BTC.tech_moat: Immutable monetary policy, highest cumulative hash rate on Earth, decentralized liquidity anchor of digital assets.
BTC.tax_audit: Under Indian Section 115BBH: Flat 30% tax on net profits + 4% cess (effective 31.2%). No set-off against losses in other crypto assets. 1% TDS deducted at source on Indian exchanges under Section 194S.
pros: Institutional spot ETF adoption (BlackRock, Fidelity)
Absolute digital scarcity (21M ceiling)
Zero counterparty sovereign risk
cons: High regulatory scrutiny from global central banks
Short-term macroeconomic correlation with tech equities
No staking yield natively

ETH.name: Ethereum
ETH.tech_moat: Undisputed settlement layer for Decentralized Finance (DeFi) and Layer-2 rollups (Arbitrum, Base, Optimism). Largest developer ecosystem in crypto.
ETH.tax_audit: Staking yields and trading profits taxed at flat 30% under Section 115BBH. Gas fee deductions are not allowable expenses under current IT rulings.
pros: Dominant settlement volume in stablecoins & tokenized RWAs
Yield generation via native validator staking (~3.2%)
Layer 2 scaling ecosystem expanding
cons: Base layer gas fees remain high during volatility
Competition from high-throughput monolithic L1s (Solana)
Staking centralization in large liquid staking pools

SOL.name: Solana
SOL.consensus: Proof of History + Proof of Stake
SOL.tech_moat: Sub-second finality (400ms slots) with transaction throughput exceeding 3,000 TPS. Unrivalled retail adoption in decentralized exchanges and meme liquidity.
SOL.tax_audit: DEX swap profits subject to 30% flat VDA tax. High-frequency micro-swaps complicate tax ledger reconciliation.
pros: Negligible transaction costs (< ₹0.10 per tx)
Explosive decentralized exchange volume
Firedancer independent validator client advancing
cons: Historical network congestion during peak meme mints
Hardware requirements for validator nodes are intensive
Higher inflation schedule than BTC/ETH

BNB.name: BNB Chain
BNB.tech_moat: Direct utility tie-in with Binance (world's largest crypto exchange by volume) for trading fee discounts, launchpool farming, and gas on BNB Smart Chain.
BNB.tax_audit: Launchpool token rewards taxed as 'Other Sources' or VDA income at 30% upon realization.
pros: Massive trading fee discount utility on Binance
Aggressive quarterly token burns reducing circulating supply
High retail wallet integration
cons: Perceived centralization around Binance corporate leadership
Regulatory oversight on centralized exchange utility tokens
EVM compatibility facing L2 competition

XRP.name: XRP (Ripple)
XRP.consensus: XRP Ledger Consensus Protocol (Federated Byzantine Agreement)
XRP.tech_moat: Ultra-fast (3-5 seconds) international remittance settlement used by cross-border banking corridors. Resolution of major US SEC programmatic sales litigation.
XRP.tax_audit: All cross-border FX settlements converted through Indian rupees attract standard Section 115BBH capital gains tax.
pros: Clear legal regulatory status following US court rulings
Sub-cent transaction settlement fees
Enterprise relationships with regional banks and remittance houses
cons: Substantial escrow release schedule managed by Ripple Labs
Competition from institutional stablecoin corridors (USDT/USDC)
Low decentralized finance composability

DOGE.name: Dogecoin
DOGE.tech_moat: First-mover advantage in cultural memetics, high retail name recognition, and auxiliary mining security tied to Litecoin.
DOGE.tax_audit: Tipping or selling DOGE triggers 30% VDA capital gains.
pros: Massive mainstream cultural brand awareness
High liquidity on every global spot exchange
Low transaction fees for peer-to-peer transfers
cons: Perpetual 5 billion annual token inflation
Concentrated whale wallet holdings
Limited smart contract capabilities natively

ADA.name: Cardano
ADA.tech_moat: Academic, peer-reviewed formal verification architecture with eUTXO transaction model for high security and determinism.
ADA.tax_audit: Staking rewards received in Daedalus/Yoroi wallets taxed at 30% under Section 115BBH upon receipt.
pros: High theoretical security and formal mathematical verification
Non-custodial, liquid staking without lockup periods
Dedicated global community following
cons: Slower feature rollout cadence due to academic peer review
DEX liquidity lower than Ethereum/Solana ecosystems
Haskell/Plutus smart contract barrier for developers

AVAX.name: Avalanche
AVAX.tech_moat: Multi-chain architecture (X, P, and C chains) supporting custom sovereign enterprise subnets with bespoke compliance rules.
AVAX.tax_audit: Standard Indian 30% VDA tax applies on C-chain and subnet transaction profits.
pros: Sub-second transaction finality
Enterprise subnet adoption in banking and gaming
Full Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) compatibility
cons: Subnet liquidity fragmentation
Validator staking bond requirements are high (2,000 AVAX)
Competition from Ethereum Layer-2 rollups

LINK.name: Chainlink
LINK.tech_moat: Near-monopoly in securing off-chain market data, price feeds, and verifiable randomness for $30+ billion in DeFi smart contracts. CCIP standard for institutional tokenization.
LINK.tax_audit: Staking v0.2 rewards taxed at flat 30% under Section 115BBH.
pros: Critical infrastructure moat — 90%+ of major DeFi protocols depend on Chainlink feeds
Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP) partnered with SWIFT
Institutional grade data infrastructure
cons: Token economics historically lagged protocol adoption
Node operator infrastructure costs are subsidized
Alternative oracle competition (Pyth Network)

NEAR.name: NEAR Protocol
NEAR.tech_moat: Dynamic state sharding ensuring unlimited horizontal scaling, human-readable account names, and leading user-owned AI decentralized compute initiatives.
NEAR.tax_audit: All sharded swap profits taxed under Section 115BBH.
pros: Seamless Web3 onboarding with named accounts
Horizontal state sharding architecture
Strong positioning at the intersection of AI compute and blockchain
cons: Ecosystem mindshare fluctuates against Solana and Base
Validator hardware demands scale with sharding
5% annual inflation rate
